title: Clew connector protocol
description: Shapes exchanged between Clew and a connector service. See docs/reference/connector-protocol.md.

id.description: Must match the id Clew was configured with.

kind.description: Core connectors live in Clew itself (D3).

source.description: Swedish. The system as shown on cards: "Heroma".

figure.description: Clew asks POST /clew/figure for a one-line figure for this area.

icon.description: One of Clew's icons. The connector sends a name, never a drawing.

description.description: Swedish. What the model reads when `model` is true.

input.description: A JSON Schema (draft 2020-12 or 7) for the value.

output.description: A JSON Schema (draft 2020-12 or 7) for the value.

model.description: Offer it to the model as a tool. Must be false for execute (D8).

scope.description: Who may call the capability at all. Omitted roles means every signed-in person. The connector narrows further in the call.

kinds.description: For `<id>.search` (D26): what it can find. Its output is a SearchOutput; `<id>.fetch` takes one of its refs back and returns one SearchHit.

view.description: How Clew draws the output: `table` and `list` over an array of records (`rows`, default "rows"; `title` names the field that names a row and is one of `fields`; `ref` the field holding the connector's ref), `detail` over one record, `text` over one Markdown string.

rows.description: A property name in the capability's output (or input).

title.description: A property name in the capability's output (or input).

key.description: A property name in the capability's output (or input).

tones.description: For `status`: the tone per value. A value without one is neutral.

ref.description: A property name in the capability's output (or input).

label.description: Swedish. The row in the menu, the name of the tool: "Telefonbok".

scan.description: Whether Clew should POST /clew/scan for each person nightly and on first visit.

delegation.description: The connector acts as the person against its system with a token Clew obtains by token exchange.

audience.description: The OAuth audience (an IdP client id) the token must be bound to.

Actor.description: The acting person as Clew knows them. Never a token.
